title: A new look for Gem Infotech
question: Choose the approach that feels right for your business. All preserve your logo, local focus and services.

options.label: The neighborhood concierge
options.thesis: Approachable local expertise with the confidence of a premium service brand.
options.viewport: Large confident headline, a warm workspace image and an integrated service chooser; gold call-to-action on deep green.
options.risk: The photography must feel like real everyday technology rather than a corporate stock image.

raised.raise: Make service relationships explicit and easy to navigate.
Commit the entire opening to one bold brand-color field.
Give service choices consistent labels and clear reading order.

options.label: The local field guide
options.thesis: A bright, practical guide to getting technology working again.
options.viewport: White opening, oversized green headline, a photograph beside two routes for home or business help.
options.risk: Familiar and clear, but less distinctive than the concierge direction.

options.label: Technical drawing
options.thesis: Tech services presented as a structured equipment specification.
options.viewport: Service specifications laid out in detailed reference columns.
options.risk: Too technical for someone simply needing help.
options.case: Lower audience identification and less immediate product clarity.

options.label: Immersive color
options.thesis: One immersive color field carries the full support experience.
options.viewport: A full-screen brand field with a central help action.
options.risk: Overly atmospheric for a practical service business.
options.case: Lower audience identification and product clarity.

options.label: Service departures
options.thesis: Services form a precise directory inspired by station information boards.
options.viewport: A dense list of services beside a prominent contact action.
options.risk: May feel transactional or imply live availability.
options.case: Lower audience identification and less clarity for an urgent visitor.
options.kept: Consistent service labels and scan order.

canonCard.label: Familiar business website
canonCard.thesis: A conventional service website using the supplied green-and-gold brand.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, two buttons and a grid of service cards.
canonCard.risk: Less distinctive from other local providers.
